labels.text: ledges: grass hangs from the edge
decor: stands anywhere, at any angle, made of 1/16 cubes
world: sets after Minecraft Dungeons screenshots
landscape: 0.5 m slabs — walkable from anywhere
rocks are impassable; dirt steps lead up the low one
